summary: Select web CI and kit plays across every queued entry not yet on the merge group's target branch.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Merge-group web change detection fetches the current target branch and diffs from its merge base with the group head instead of the preceding queue entry. A failed target fetch or missing merge base runs all web lanes. Pull-request merge-base and push before-to-after behavior remain unchanged; push before already covers the entire pushed range.
